offer.text: The smokehouse is empty and market day's coming. Bring me 8 cooked porkchops and I'll stock the stall.

accept.text: Good. Folk pay well for a proper roast.

decline.text: Empty hooks make for a poor butcher.

in_progress.text: Any pork for the smokehouse yet?

ready.text: Eight fine chops! The stall will sell out by noon.

complete.text: You've a knack for this. Come back any time.
